purpose: Curated upstream sources for NixOS work in mediNix-core. Consumed by agents via jq; see 'usage' for one-line queries.
provenance: Ursprung: `docs/learn/LEARN-50-gold-nuggets.md` (Projekt „mynixos", 2026-03), aufgelöst in Commit `2176c2c`. Alle 19 Links übernommen; die Sammlung wurde um Kuratierung (`relevance`, `use_cases`, `why`) und BANNED-Referenzen erweitert.

categories.standard-docs: Official Nix / NixOS / nixpkgs documentation. Machine-readable where possible.
categories.patterns: Reference flake configs and module collections for architecture comparison. Do not copy verbatim; mediNix has its own conventions.
categories.server-ops: Server hardening, deployment, declarative disks, impermanence. Some are direct comparisons to mediNix modules.
categories.security: CVE tracking and hardening references. Some entries are banned in mediNix and listed only as 'why we do it differently'.
categories.tools: Daily-use tools. Most are already in the flake devShell or checks.
categories.community: Forum, chat, discussion. For 'how do others do X?' questions.
categories.nixos-org-infra: Repositories of the nixos.org infrastructure team. Not project-relevant; kept for historical context only.
categories.banned-reference: Technologies explicitly banned in 50-core/BANNED_TECHNOLOGIES.md. Listed to explain what mediNix intentionally avoids.

entries.title: nix.dev
entries.why: Official Nix documentation. Start here for language basics, flakes, and module system.

entries.title: NixOS/nixpkgs
entries.why: The package set and NixOS modules. Every option and package mediNix uses comes from here; `nix search nixpkgs` and `nixos-option` query it.

entries.title: NixOS Manual (stable)
entries.why: Versioned manual. Option reference and service documentation.

entries.title: nixpkgs Manual (stable)
entries.why: Package build reference. Relevant for packages/arr-provision and packages/medinix-cli.

entries.title: Nix Language Basics
entries.why: Language reference. Needed when reading or writing Nix expressions.

entries.title: NixOS Wiki
entries.why: Community knowledge. Often more current than the manual for 'how do I X?' questions.

entries.title: NixOS & Flakes Book (ryan4yin)
entries.why: Best free Flakes book. Opinionated but readable.

entries.title: search.nixos.org
entries.api_caveat: Elasticsearch backend, not a stable public API. Breaks without warning.
entries.why: Options and package search. For offline/preferred: `nixos-option <path>` on host, or `nix eval --json` inside the repo.

entries.title: Misterio77/nix-starter-configs
entries.why: Clean flake templates. Compare structure, do not copy.

entries.title: Misterio77/nix-config
entries.why: Real-world homelab flake. Useful as an architecture reference.

entries.title: hlissner/dotfiles
entries.why: Module structure reference. Older style.

entries.title: nix-community/home-manager
entries.why: User dotfile management. Not part of mediNix-core; relevant if the host config wants it.

entries.title: numtide/flake-utils
entries.why: Used in mediNix-core flake.nix (eachDefaultSystem).

entries.title: hercules-ci/flake-parts
entries.why: Dendritic pattern helper. Explicitly not used in mediNix-core (see AGENTS.md). Reference only.

entries.title: nix-community/srvos
entries.why: Server-hardening profiles. Direct comparison to 50-core/hardening-profiles.nix.

entries.title: nix-community/impermanence
entries.why: Ephemeral root filesystem. Not used in mediNix; relevant for future hardening.

entries.title: nix-community/nixos-anywhere
entries.why: Remote installation via SSH. Relevant when mediNix is deployed for the first time.

entries.title: nix-community/disko
entries.why: Declarative disk partitioning. Not used; relevant for reproducible installs.

entries.title: nix-community/lanzaboote
entries.why: Secure Boot for NixOS. Not used; relevant for boot-chain integrity.

entries.title: NixOS/nixos-hardware
entries.why: Hardware quirks. Not an input today; relevant when hardware-specific modules are needed.

entries.title: rasmus-kirk/nixarr
entries.why: Media-server module collection. Direct comparison to 53/54/55/56 modules.

entries.title: nix-community/vulnix
entries.api_notes: CLI produces JSON with --json; no daemon required.
entries.why: CVE scanner for NixOS closures. Recommended if mediNix ever wants CVE monitoring.

entries.title: NixOS/nix-security-tracker
entries.why: CVE web service. Reference only; no integration.

entries.title: cynicsketch/nix-mineral
entries.why: Extreme hardening module. Comparison only; conflicts with mediNix's profile-based approach.

entries.title: nix-community/nh
entries.why: Better output for nixos-rebuild. Already in the flake devShell.

entries.title: nix-community/nix-index-database

entries.title: utdemir/nix-tree
entries.why: Interactive dependency graph. Already in the flake devShell.

entries.title: khumba/nvd

entries.title: astro/deadnix
